ARCEP's own operating complaint channel, the mechanism itself rather than a description of one: free call centre 8000, mail, e-mail, Messenger, WhatsApp, web form and web chat.

Distinct event: ANASAP opened a dedicated WhatsApp line on 19 January 2026 for Grand Lome residents to report sanitation problems with photos, video and geolocation.
A live procedure on the national service-public portal letting any person over 18, resident or diaspora, submit suggestions on security services, administrative procedures and civil protection.
